# ToolbarWrapper

A horizontal toolbar container with a `gray100` background, a `start` slot on the left and an `end` slot on the right, and an optional bottom divider. Use it to build list headers, filter bars, and date-navigation bars above content areas.

```ts
import { ToolbarWrapper } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

`start` anchors content to the left (summary text, counts, date controls); `end` anchors action controls to the right (search, filter, action buttons). Both slots accept any `ReactNode`.

```tsx preview
import { ToolbarWrapper, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';
import Icon from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-icon';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <ToolbarWrapper
      start={
        <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.textDefault}>
          80 Agents
        </Typography>
      }
      end={
        <Flex alignY="center" gap={2}>
          <Input
            placeholder="Search by agent"
            size="small"
            prefix={<Icon name="search" size="tiny" />}
          />
          <Button type="secondary" size="small">
            + Create blank agent
          </Button>
          <Button type="secondary" variation="transparent" size="small">
            <Icon name="filter_list" size="tiny" />
            <Typography variant="caption" inline>
              Filters
            </Typography>
          </Button>
        </Flex>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## End-only toolbar (no start content)

When `start` is omitted the `end` slot is still right-aligned. Use this for toolbars where no left-side summary is needed.

```tsx preview
import { ToolbarWrapper, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Input from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-input';
import Icon from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-icon';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <ToolbarWrapper
      end={
        <Flex alignY="center" gap={2}>
          <Input
            placeholder="Search by all queues"
            size="small"
            prefix={<Icon name="search" size="tiny" />}
          />
          <Button type="secondary" variation="transparent" size="small">
            <Icon name="filter_list" size="tiny" />
            <Typography variant="caption" inline>
              Filters
            </Typography>
          </Button>
        </Flex>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## Rich start slot — date navigation

The `start` slot supports any controls. This example composes a real schedule toolbar entirely from `@wfm/ui-components`: a `DatePicker` for the current day, three `Button` controls (with the new `iconName` prop) for prev/today/next, and a `Dropdown` for view mode. The Filters button on the right opens a `SidePanel` containing a small filter form (status `MultiDropdown` + date range), with Reset/Apply actions in the footer.

> Why the explicit widths and heights? `DatePicker` and `Dropdown` are built on **different Cobalt families** — `DatePicker` renders a `FormField` (`InputGroup` + `Input` + icon cell, plus an internal 2px wrapper for popup padding), while `Dropdown` renders the marketplace `Input` directly. Even with both set to `size="small"`, the DatePicker is ~4px taller. To line them up in a toolbar, wrap each trigger in a `Box` with a fixed `width` _and_ `height: 32` and pass `isFullWidth` so the trigger stretches to fill it.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Button,
  DatePicker,
  Dropdown,
  MultiDropdown,
  SidePanel,
  ToolbarWrapper,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const viewOptions = [
  { value: 'day', label: 'Day' },
  { value: 'week', label: 'Week' },
  { value: 'month', label: 'Month' },
];

const statusOptions = [
  { value: 'scheduled', label: 'Scheduled' },
  { value: 'in_progress', label: 'In progress' },
  { value: 'completed', label: 'Completed' },
  { value: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled' },
];

const formatHeader = (d) =>
  d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
    year: 'numeric',
  });

// Shared trigger height so DatePicker (FormField + 2px wrapper) and Dropdown
// (marketplace Input) line up. 32 = small input height in Cobalt.
const TRIGGER_HEIGHT = 32;

export default function Demo() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date(2026, 3, 24));
  const [view, setView] = useState('day');
  const [filterOpen, setFilterOpen] = useState(false);
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState(['scheduled', 'in_progress']);
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(new Date(2026, 3, 20));
  const [to, setTo] = useState(new Date(2026, 3, 27));

  const shiftDay = (delta) => {
    const next = new Date(date);
    next.setDate(next.getDate() + delta);
    setDate(next);
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setStatuses([]);
    setFrom(new Date(2026, 3, 20));
    setTo(new Date(2026, 3, 27));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ToolbarWrapper
        start={
          <Flex alignY="center" gap={2}>
            <Box style={{ width: 180, height: TRIGGER_HEIGHT }}>
              <DatePicker
                isFullWidth
                value={date}
                formatDate={formatHeader}
                onChange={setDate}
                data-qa="schedule-date"
              />
            </Box>
            <Button
              iconName="chevron_left"
              shape="compact"
              size="small"
              type="secondary"
              aria-label="Previous day"
              onClick={() => shiftDay(-1)}
            />
            <Button
              size="small"
              type="secondary"
              onClick={() => setDate(new Date())}
            >
              Today
            </Button>
            <Button
              iconName="chevron_right"
              shape="compact"
              size="small"
              type="secondary"
              aria-label="Next day"
              onClick={() => shiftDay(1)}
            />
            <Box style={{ width: 140, height: TRIGGER_HEIGHT }}>
              <Dropdown
                size="small"
                value={view}
                options={viewOptions}
                onChange={(v) => setView(v)}
                data-qa="view-mode"
              />
            </Box>
          </Flex>
        }
        end={
          <Flex alignY="center" gap={2}>
            <Button
              iconName="sort"
              size="small"
              type="secondary"
              variation="transparent"
            >
              Sort options
            </Button>
            <Button
              iconName="filter_list"
              size="small"
              type="secondary"
              variation="transparent"
              onClick={() => setFilterOpen(true)}
            >
              Filters
            </Button>
          </Flex>
        }
      />

      <SidePanel
        visible={filterOpen}
        title="Filters"
        size="small"
        onClose={() => setFilterOpen(false)}
        actions={[
          { label: 'Reset', type: 'secondary', onClick: resetFilters },
          {
            label: 'Apply',
            type: 'primary',
            onClick: () => setFilterOpen(false),
          },
        ]}
      >
        <Flex direction="column" gap={4} width="100%">
          <MultiDropdown
            label="Status"
            value={statuses}
            options={statusOptions}
            onChange={setStatuses}
            messages={{ placeholder: 'Any status' }}
            data-qa="filter-status"
          />
          <DatePicker
            isFullWidth
            label="From"
            value={from}
            onChange={setFrom}
            data-qa="filter-from"
          />
          <DatePicker
            isFullWidth
            label="To"
            value={to}
            onChange={setTo}
            data-qa="filter-to"
          />
        </Flex>
      </SidePanel>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Without border

Set `isBordered={false}` to remove the bottom divider when the content below already provides sufficient visual separation.

```tsx preview
import { ToolbarWrapper, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <ToolbarWrapper
      isBottomBordered={false}
      start={
        <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.textDefault}>
          Borderless toolbar
        </Typography>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## Top Bordered

Set `isTopBordered={true}` to render a 1 px border above the toolbar. Use this when the toolbar is not at the very top of its section and needs a visual separator from the content above it.

```tsx preview
import { ToolbarWrapper, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <Box style={{ border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`, borderRadius: 4 }}>
      <Box padding="3">
        <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.basic600}>
          Content above toolbar
        </Typography>
      </Box>
      <ToolbarWrapper
        isTopBordered
        start={
          <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.textDefault}>
            Toolbar with top border
          </Typography>
        }
      />
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Custom Padding

Use `paddingX` and `paddingY` to override the default spacing inside the toolbar. Both accept `Space` tokens (multiples of 4 px). Use tighter padding for compact toolbars or larger padding for prominent action bars.

- Left: `paddingX={2}` / `paddingY={1}` — compact (8 px / 4 px)
- Right: `paddingX={8}` / `paddingY={4}` — generous (32 px / 16 px)

```tsx preview
import { ToolbarWrapper, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="4">
      <ToolbarWrapper
        paddingX={2}
        paddingY={1}
        start={
          <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.textDefault}>
            Compact padding (paddingX=2, paddingY=1)
          </Typography>
        }
      />
      <ToolbarWrapper
        paddingX={8}
        paddingY={4}
        start={
          <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.textDefault}>
            Generous padding (paddingX=8, paddingY=4)
          </Typography>
        }
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop               | Type        | Default               | Description                                                 |
| ------------------ | ----------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `start`            | `ReactNode` | —                     | Left-anchored content — summary text, counts, date controls |
| `end`              | `ReactNode` | —                     | Right-anchored content — search, filter, and action buttons |
| `isTopBordered`    | `boolean`   | `false`               | Renders a 1 px top border above the toolbar                 |
| `isBottomBordered` | `boolean`   | `true`                | Renders a 1 px bottom border below the toolbar              |
| `paddingX`         | `Space`     | `4`                   | Horizontal padding token — `4` = 16 px                      |
| `paddingY`         | `Space`     | `2`                   | Vertical padding token — `2` = 8 px                         |
| `data-qa`          | `string`    | —                     | QA selector                                                 |
| `data-component`   | `string`    | `'WFMToolbarWrapper'` | Component identifier                                        |
